name: Iovantucarus

attributes.attribute: a Continental Celtic god whose name means the one who loves the young, a god of children or adolescents
interpreted by the Romans as both Mars the warrior god and Mercury the god of commerce and eloquence

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Iovantucarus is a Continental Celtic god. Scholars translate his name as the one who loves the young. This reading suggests a god of children or adolescents. The Romans interpreted him as the warrior god Mars. They also linked him with the god of commerce and eloquence, Mercury.

okr.objective: Document the Continental Celtic god Iovantucarus.
key_results: Translate the name Iovantucarus as the one who loves the young.
Record the Roman identification with Mars and Mercury.
